subject: Change order: pilot throughput top-up, acceptance tests and capped overage billing
messages:
From: procurement@phenomai.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Change order: pilot throughput top-up, acceptance tests and capped overage billing

Marissa,

Thanks for running the integration demo with our SRE team. We reviewed Redwood's proposed SOW and have a few change-order requests so we can kick off the pilot next week: 

1) Pilot throughput increase: add a 30% top-up to the contracted pilot throughput (roughly +160M tokens/month) for the 90-day pilot.
2) Acceptance criteria: define end-to-end integration tests - p95 latency across representative traffic < 250ms and a sample evaluation on our benchmark set with F1 >= 0.78. Tests must be reproducible in our staging environment.
3) Billing alignment: overages during the 90-day pilot should be capped at a fixed monthly dollar amount (Phenoma proposes $1,200/mo cap) and invoiced monthly. No daily pro-ration for the pilot.
4) Minor SOW edit: add a one-week implementation window for remediation if acceptance fails.

Attached is a marked-up PDF (Phenoma_CO_Request_v1.pdf) with preferred language. Please loop in your legal and accounting and send back Redwood's redlines and any delta to monthly fees (we need the figure before procurement can sign).

We can do a 30-minute call Monday 2026-06-08 at 10:00 PT to run through open items.

Thanks,
Priya Malhotra
Head of Procurement, Phenoma Inc.
procurement@phenomai.com

Attachment: Phenoma_CO_Request_v1.pdf (redlines + SOW excerpt)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@phenomai.com
Date: 2026-06-08T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Change order: pilot throughput top-up, acceptance tests and capped overage billing

Marissa/Karthik,

Quick legal read of Phenoma's requests and our draft: key points to surface to the customer before sign:

- Acceptance language: Phenoma's proposed P95 < 250ms and F1 >= 0.78 are operationally specific. We can agree to run those tests in staging using a mutually-agreed dataset and test harness; however, we should not tie automatic financial remedies to a single snapshot. Propose: "Acceptance testing performed jointly; failure triggers remediation window and repeat testing; payment/credits only if failure persists after two retest cycles."

- Liability/indemnity: Phenoma redline removes Redwood limit of liability for data misuse. We must preserve Redwood's standard liability cap (fees x 12) and decline broad indemnity tied to third-party claims. Recommend we offer narrower indemnity scoped to Redwood's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

- Billing cap: Capped overage language is commercially fine for a timeboxed pilot. Need a clear definition of "overage" (tokens billed above committed throughput) and an explicit monthly cap number. Also call out invoice timing and dispute window (30 days).

- Implementation window: one-week remediation is tight for production fixes. Recommend 14-day remediation for non-critical issues and a 3-day response SLA for critical P1 items.

I'll attach a redline (Phenoma_Redline_v2.docx) with alternate wording and an internal estimate of the legal risk points (marissa_redline_notes.xlsx). Once we have commercial agreement on the cap and the monthly fee delta, I can sign off on legal wording.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: marissa_redline_notes.xlsx, redwood_legal_redline_v1.docx

From: procurement@phenomai.com (Priya Malhotra)
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: asha.rao@phenomai.com
Date: 2026-06-09T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Change order: pilot throughput top-up, acceptance tests and capped overage billing

Laura/Marissa,

Thanks for the fast turnaround and the suggested language. Asha and I reviewed Laura's redline and we're comfortable with the joint acceptance testing workflow (two retest cycles). On liability: Phenoma still prefers narrower carveouts, but we can live with Redwood's standard cap if we get clearer language around data segregation and audit logs during the pilot.

On the commercial side: Phenoma can accept a $1,200/mo capped overage for the 90-day pilot provided Redwood confirms the monthly delta to committed fees before the call on Monday. If Redwood proposes a phased 30% top-up, please provide the incremental monthly fee so procurement can route for approval (we need the number and a simple one-line rationale for finance).

I've attached our revised redline (Phenoma_Redline_v2.docx). We're keen to sign this week and start the pilot on 2026-06-20.

Best,
Priya Malhotra
Head of Procurement, Phenoma Inc.
procurement@phenomai.com

Attachment: Phenoma_Redline_v2.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: procurement@phenomai.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2026-06-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Change order: pilot throughput top-up, acceptance tests and capped overage billing

Priya 99

Thanks999for the patience while we finalized terms. Summary of agreed change order items below (see attached CO_final_for_signing.docx):

- Throughput: 30% phased top-up for the first 30 days of the pilot (adds ~160M tokens/month). After day 30 parties will review consumption and either continue at the increased baseline or step down to original baseline.
- Acceptance: Jointly-run acceptance tests in Phenoma staging. Acceptance criteria: p95 end-to-end latency < 250ms, benchmark F1 >= 0.78; two retest cycles allowed. Failure => 14-day remediation window for non-critical issues; 3-day SLA for critical issues.
- Billing: Pilot overages defined as billed tokens above committed throughput; capped at $1,200/month for the 90-day pilot. Invoices monthly; 30-day payment and 30-day dispute window.
- Liability/indemnity: Redwood standard liability cap (fees x 12) retained; Redwood will provide pilot-only audit log access and a data segregation attestation for the pilot period.

Commercial delta: the incremental fee to support the phased 30% top-up during the pilot is $18,000/month (reflects reserved burst capacity and SRE support during pilot). This is a one-line commercial justification for procurement: "Reserved burst capacity + pilot SRE support."

Next steps: Laura has prepared the final change order and we've bundled the agreed edits into CO_final_for_signing.docx. Priya, if this matches your expectation, we'll send for e-signature via DocuSign and schedule the kickoff for 2026-06-20.

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
